prompt: /deliver-issues — Quang signed off this week's board. Deliver every ticket that's ready while I'm out until 5; PRs up when I'm back. (Three tickets have approved plans of 2–4 small tasks each.)
assertions: each eligible ticket's tasks are built through build-in-waves with an implementer dispatch and a review per task
each ticket's branch gets inspect-change before its PR
each PR is opened through land-branch, never by the controller writing every task itself

prompt: /deliver-issues — deliver the board while I'm away. (One plan adds a value to a status that a consumer documented in docs/api.md parses as a closed enum; another ticket is Blocked by that one.)
assertions: the ticket is built with the option that keeps the documented contract
its PR body opens with Needs a decision before merge: the question, the option built, the one-line change for the other
the blocked ticket is built on the blocker's branch and its PR is based on it

prompt: /deliver-issues — deliver every ready ticket. (One ready ticket is approved but has no requirements, design or plan.)
assertions: no code or spec is written for that ticket
the message's table lists it as not eligible with the piece it lacks
